ctl.title: Remote Control
ctl.accEnabled: Accessibility service enabled — remote control ready
ctl.accSteps:
Setup steps:
1. Tap the button below to open Accessibility settings directly.
2. Find NexusLink in the list of downloaded services.
3. Open it and turn on "Use service".
4. Confirm the warning dialog — the service does nothing outside a control session you explicitly accept.
ctl.confirmTitle: Ask for confirmation at session start
ctl.confirmSubtitle: When enabled, an Allow/Deny notification appears before the computer touches your screen. When disabled, sessions start automatically from trusted devices only.
ctl.trustedSubtitle: Devices not paired and trusted in the server registry cannot request control at all — requests are rejected before reaching your phone.
ctl.howBody: When a session starts from the computer, its touches are injected on your phone through the accessibility service with pixel precision: tap, long-press, drag, scroll, text into the focused field, and system buttons (back/home/recents). You can cut instantly from the home screen or here at any time, and control always ends when the server connection is lost.
